name: setup
title_zh: 从零到连上第一家银行，全程只走你机器上的本地命令
tagline_zh: 装过 MCP 的人最怕暗坑：Node 版本、注册路径、Enable Banking 申请页。
tagline_en: No more guessing where MCP setup breaks. This Skill walks you through Node check, server registration, Enable.
desc_en: Set up BankMCP™ on this machine step by step: check Node, register the local MCP server, walk through the Enable Banking application, finish the setup page and connect the first bank. Use when the user says "set up bankmcp", "install bankmcp", "/setup", "connect my bank for the first time", or has BankMCP tools that report "not set up yet".
why_zh: 不是丢给你一篇文档，而是逐条执行并检查结果：Node 版本不对就停下，注册失败就报具体错误。
why_en: It doesn't just print instructions—it verifies each step's output before proceeding. Node version wrong? It stops. Registration.
limit_zh: 只负责本机首次配置，不处理银行侧审核、不修已有连接故障、不支持非 Enable Banking 的银行。
limit_en: First-time local setup only. Won't handle bank-side approval, fix broken existing connections, or support non-Enable-Banking banks. If you've.
title_en: Local step-by-step BankMCP setup to first bank link
